[Thinking]
**Classifying real estate development**

I need to classify real estate development into two main types: residential and commercial office. It looks like both categories serve different markets, with residential being business-to-consumer (B2C) and commercial office leaning towards business-to-business (B2B). I think recognizing this distinction will help clarify the overall landscape of real estate development. It’s interesting how these segments connect with different target audiences!
[/Thinking]

Both

Indiabulls Real Estate develops:
- Residential projects for individual buyers: B2C
- Commercial and office projects for businesses/investors: B2B

So the company serves both consumer and business customers.
